tasks.label: g++ build active file
args: export PATH=/mingw64/bin:$PATH; FILE=$(cygpath '${file}'); OUTDIR=$(cygpath '${fileDirname}'); g++ -std=c++17 -O2 "$FILE" -o "$OUTDIR/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" && echo 'Build OK' || echo 'Build FAILED'
tasks.detail: Build with MinGW GCC via MSYS2 bash (supports bits/stdc++.h)
